get.summary: One resource's events from one sequence number
get.description: The events of one resource whose sequence number is at least `fromSequence`, in log order. The one read of the event log this surface serves, and deliberately narrow: a range of one resource, never the whole log. The gateway calls it to replay a scope a subscriber resumes, asking from the sequence after the last one the subscriber saw.

parameters.name: fromSequence
parameters.description: The first sequence number wanted, inclusive.

400.description: No resource, or `fromSequence` is not an integer of at least 1.

500.description: The log could not be read.
